1.kind: compound modifier 贞孝节烈 not split into two separate mod concepts (贞孝 and 节烈)
1.cause: Annotator treated 贞孝节烈 as one four-character modifier instead of two coordinated/parallel modifiers (贞孝 and 节烈), so 节烈 was not found and 贞孝 got the wrong concept.
1.convention: Four-character compounds made of two juxtaposed two-character words are segmented into separate concepts, each attached as its own :mod.

1.kind: place attached to the wrong head: :place on 产物 instead of inside the 古代 (era) node
1.cause: Annotator attached 中国 as :place of 产物 as a sibling of :era, whereas gold nests the country under 古代 (中国古代 = ancient China, a unit modifying the era).
1.convention: In a 'place + time-period' modifier like 中国古代, the place is attached under the era/time concept rather than directly to the head noun.

1.kind: temporal relation direction/format mismatch (annotator wrote (s1i :overlap DCT) rather than (DCT :overlap s1i))
1.cause: Annotator reversed argument order for document-creation-time relations, so the evaluator counted the gold relations as missing.
1.convention: Document-level temporal relations for events are written with document-creation-time as the first argument: (document-creation-time :overlap event).

1.kind: spurious subset-of coref between the 牌坊 in the 一种 predicate nominal and the topic 牌坊 within the same identity-91 sentence; missing subset-of links from later sentences' 牌坊 to the sentence-1 牌坊
1.cause: Annotator added a subset-of link between the two nodes of the identity-91 construction (already expressed by identity-91), while not linking later specific 牌坊 mentions (snt12, 21, 23) as subsets of the generic 牌坊, and chain membership of later mentions diverged.
1.convention: The class-membership/identity-91 predicate already encodes the relation within the sentence, so no coref is added there; later specific instances of the generic 牌坊 are linked with :subset-of to the generic mention.

1.kind: extra temporal annotations in later sentences (e.g., events marked :before document-creation-time) not in gold
1.cause: Annotator assigned :before DCT to events in sentence 10 (倡议, 要求, 引发) where gold has no such relation; unrelated to sentence 1's content.

2.kind: Compound modifier 贞孝节烈 not split into two separate mod concepts (贞孝, 节烈)
2.cause: The annotator treated 贞孝节烈 as a single four-character word and did not segment it into two coordinated modifiers, so 节烈 was missing and the concept 贞孝 was wrong.
2.convention: Four-character coordinated compounds made of two parallel two-character items are split into separate concepts, each attached as its own :mod.

2.kind: Wrong relation label for 社会: possessor used instead of place (中国 封建 社会 的 制度)
2.cause: The annotator read 的 as a possessive marker and chose :possessor, whereas the gold treats the 社会 as the location/setting of the 制度 and uses :place.
2.convention: A noun phrase modifying an institution or system with 的 that gives its social or spatial setting is labeled :place rather than :possessor.

2.kind: 旌表 analyzed as an event with ARG1 贞节 and an -00 sense instead of a noun concept with :mod 贞节
2.cause: The annotator treated 旌表 as a verbal predicate (旌表-00) with an ARG1 and an :aspect activity, but the gold keeps 旌表 as a plain noun concept modified by 贞节. The annotator's event analysis also led to an extra modal annotation and the missing :mod of 贞节.
2.convention: Nominal modifiers inside a compound noun (e.g. 贞节旌表制度) are kept as plain noun concepts with :mod, not as eventive predicates with core arguments. Such non-event nouns do not receive their own temporal or modal entries.

2.kind: Extra modal and temporal annotations for 旌表 event
2.cause: Because 旌表 was annotated as an event, the annotator added author :full-affirmative and :before DCT for it, which the gold does not have.
2.convention: Only genuine event predicates in the sentence receive modal and temporal relations.

2.kind: Temporal relations not matched because of direction/format difference
2.cause: The annotator wrote (s2i :overlap document-creation-time) and (s2d :before document-creation-time), putting the DCT as the object. The gold has DCT as the head, i.e. (document-creation-time :overlap s2i2) and (document-creation-time :before s2z1). The reversed direction means the relations were not counted as matching.
2.convention: Document-creation-time is the first element (head) of temporal relations: (document-creation-time :rel event).

2.kind: Coreference chain differs: spurious 旌表 chain, and incomplete/different 牌坊 chain
2.cause: The annotator linked repeated mentions of 旌表 as same-entity across the document (treating them as event coreference), and the 制度 chain was extended with 旌表 mentions. In the 牌坊 chain it missed some mentions such as 年间 and was incomplete.
2.convention: Repeated mentions of 旌表 as a modifier inside compounds are not coreferent with one another or with 制度. Only genuinely identical referents are chained.

3.kind: Missing head noun 行为 (behavior); 守节/守孝 attached directly under 表扬 with the agent 女性 as ARG0 instead of 行为 with possessor 女性
3.cause: Annotator dropped the nominal head 行为 and treated 守节/守孝 as eventive predicates (-00 senses) with an ARG0, instead of modelling the overt noun 行为 as the ARG1 of 表扬 with a possessor
3.convention: Overt head nouns in the text are kept as concepts; a modifying verbal phrase or possessor is attached to the head noun (mod/possessor) rather than the head being dropped and the modifier promoted to a predicate with ARG0. Nominalized event words under a head noun are plain concepts without -00 and aspect.

3.kind: Possessor 妇女 attached to each conjunct separately (with a re-entrant) instead of once to the 'and' node
3.cause: Annotator distributed the shared modifier over both conjuncts and created a re-entrancy, which also generated spurious coreference (贞操 same-entity 妇女)
3.convention: A modifier shared by coordinated items is attached once to the coordination node (and) rather than copied to each conjunct. Possessor/part-of relations are not coreference chains.

3.kind: Era 封建时代 as one concept, with 封建 also as mod of 社会 (wrong placement); gold has era 时代 with mod 封建
3.cause: Annotator merged 封建 and 时代 into one lexical concept and also duplicated 封建 as a mod of 社会, whereas the text has 封建 modifying 时代
3.convention: Compound noun phrases are split into head concept plus modifier; modifiers are attached to the noun they actually modify in the text and not duplicated.

3.cause: Annotator did not give identity-91 (copular clause) an aspect
3.convention: Copular/stative predicates such as identity-91 receive :aspect state.

3.kind: Temporal relations wrong: annotator anchored 看重 before DCT and made 守节/守孝 overlap 表扬; gold has DCT before 看重 (s3x) and identity-91, and past-reference depends-on 表扬
3.cause: Annotator mis-anchored event times: the main eventive predicates (看重 and the copular identity-91) were not linked to the DCT properly, and the embedded purpose event 表扬 was not given a generic past-reference anchoring; it instead put the nominal-like 守节/守孝 on the temporal graph
3.convention: Main clause predicates, including the copular identity-91, get a relation to the document-creation-time. Purposive/generic embedded events are anchored with past-reference :depends-on. Event-like nominal modifiers within a head noun are not given temporal relations.

3.kind: Modal annotation: author full-affirmative given to have-cause-91, 守节, 守孝 but not to identity-91 and 表扬
3.cause: Annotator put modal relations on the causal relation node and on the (non-head) 守节/守孝, while omitting the copular identity-91 predicate
3.convention: Modal relations are applied to the actual event predicates (including copular identity-91 and 表扬), not to the have-cause-91 relation node and not to nominal modifier events.

3.kind: Coreference chain errors: 牌坊 chain includes spurious mention (年间) and wrong antecedent/link; spurious chains for 守节, 守孝, 妇女, 贞操
3.cause: Annotator over-linked repeated or related terms into coreference chains and anchored the 牌坊 link to s2p instead of s1x
3.convention: Only truly identical referents are linked; generic repeated mentions of event nouns or possessed entities are not coreference chains.

4.kind: have-cause-91 arguments reversed (effect as ARG1, cause as ARG2 swapped)
4.cause: In the 因为…所以… construction the annotator put the 因为 (cause) clause as ARG1 and the 所以 (effect) clause as ARG2. Gold puts the effect (区分) as ARG1 and the cause (不同) as ARG2.
4.convention: have-cause-91: ARG1 is the effect/result, ARG2 is the cause/reason, regardless of clause order in the sentence.

4.kind: 每个 not decomposed into quant 每 and unit 个; kept as a single quant string and misplaced on 事迹
4.cause: The annotator treated 每个 as a single value on 事迹. Gold splits it into concept 每 (:quant) and 个 (:unit), attached to 人士 (the possessor).
4.convention: Quantifier plus classifier is split into :quant (quantifier word) and :unit (classifier) as separate concepts, attached to the noun they modify; they are not a single attribute string.

4.cause: The annotator dropped the distributive adverb 均 and did not annotate it as :mod on 不同-01.
4.convention: Adverbs such as 均 (all/both) are annotated as a :mod concept on the predicate rather than omitted.

4.kind: ARG2 coordination structure: annotator coordinated repeated 牌坊 nodes under and; gold has one 牌坊 whose :mod is an and of the types
4.cause: The annotator distributed the head noun 牌坊 over each coordinated modifier and created five 牌坊 nodes under 'and'. The gold has a single 牌坊 and coordinates only the modifiers, in a shared-head enumeration with 等.
4.convention: When coordinated items share a head noun (X、Y、Z 牌坊), coordinate the modifiers under a single head noun rather than duplicating the head.

4.kind: wrong coref: subset-of relations to 人士 and a same-entity chain linking sentence 3's 牌坊 to s4p; gold links 牌坊 to earlier mentions
4.cause: The annotator mis-resolved the antecedent, linking the 牌坊 subtypes as subsets of 人士 (s4p) and chaining the 人士 node with the 牌坊 chain, instead of treating the generic 牌坊 (s4a) as co-referent with the earlier 牌坊 mentions. Subtype nodes were also created that gold does not mark as subsets.
4.convention: Coreference should link repeated mentions of the same entity (here the 牌坊 as a class) across sentences; subset-of is not used for subtypes listed within a coordination or for unrelated entities.

4.kind: document-level temporal relations missing or misaligned because of graph differences
4.cause: The annotator's relations were on s4d, s4r and s4q, with the direction written as (node :overlap document-creation-time). Gold uses document-creation-time as the source, and has no relation for the have-cause-91 node. The cited missing units largely follow from the structural mismatches above and the relation direction.
4.convention: Temporal relations are stated with document-creation-time as the first argument, and not on the have-cause-91 relation node itself.

4.kind: extra modal annotations on have-cause-91 and on 表扬-01
4.cause: The annotator added author :full-affirmative on the have-cause-91 node and on the embedded 表扬-01 modifier event. The gold only marks the main events (区分, 不同).
4.convention: Modal relations are marked on the main clause events; relation nodes like have-cause-91 and events in a modifier/relative clause (表扬-01) do not get their own modal annotation.

5.kind: Comparative/superlative '最早' modeled as have-degree-91 with ARG2/ARG3 instead of simple 早 modifier with :degree 最
5.cause: Annotator applied the have-degree-91 template to 最早 and attached it as ARG1-of on 记载; gold treats 早 as a plain :mod of the noun with 最 as its :degree.
5.convention: Superlative/degree adverbs like 最 modifying an adjective are annotated as :degree of the adjective (a :mod on the head), not with have-degree-91, unless a comparison is explicit.

5.kind: Noun 记载 treated as an event (记载-01, aspect performance, ARG1) instead of a plain non-event concept with :topic for the about-phrase
5.cause: Annotator treated the nominal 记载 as a PropBank event and attached 牌坊 as ARG1 and gave it temporal/modal annotations; gold keeps it as an entity with 牌坊 as :topic.
5.convention: Nouns like 记载 'record/account' with an 有关...的 phrase are annotated as non-eventive concepts with :topic for the 'about' content, and receive no temporal/modal relations.

5.kind: Wrong structure for 旌表贞节制度: 旌表 made an event (旌表-00) modifying 制度 with 贞节 as ARG1; gold has 贞节 as :mod of 制度 and 旌表 as :mod of 贞节
5.cause: Annotator parsed 旌表 as a verb with an object, creating an event with aspect, modal and coreference links; gold treats it as a nominal modifier compound.
5.convention: Nominal modifier compounds are annotated as :mod chains of entities, not as events; thus no modal/coref event relations are produced.

5.kind: Spurious modal annotations on non-event or non-main nodes (but-91, 保证, 旌表, 记载)
5.cause: Annotator added full-affirmative to every node including the but-91 conjunction and nominal concepts; gold only marks the main events 存在, 追溯, 得到.
5.convention: Modal annotations are applied only to event predicates that are actual events; discourse relations like but-91 and nominalised/non-event concepts do not receive them.

5.kind: 保证 treated as an event (保证-00 with aspect state) and given its own temporal relation; gold treats it as a plain concept
5.cause: Annotator treated the object nominal 保证 as an event and added (保证 :overlap 得到); gold keeps it as a noun, so the temporal link belongs to 得到 only.
5.convention: Abstract nouns serving as objects of light-ish verbs like 得到 are non-event concepts without aspect or temporal links.

5.kind: Missing/incorrect document-level temporal relations: 存在 and 追溯 relations are mismatched (existence :before DCT missing/ misattached to different node; 追溯 :overlap DCT missing)
5.cause: Annotator's relations were attached to different nodes (s5e, s5h) and they were not matched due to the graph differences; the but-91 node received a spurious :before DCT and 追溯 was matched only partially. Possibly the evaluator's alignment failed because of the extra relations.
5.convention: Temporal relations to DCT are given for event predicates in the main clauses; the discourse connective but-91 gets none.

5.kind: Time phrase 在明代年间 annotated with :era and a duplicated 明代 rather than :temporal 年间 with :op1 明代
5.cause: Annotator dropped 年间 as a concept and used :era; gold reifies 年间 as a temporal noun with :op1 明代.
5.convention: Temporal nouns like 年间 'period' are kept as concepts under :temporal with the named period as :op1.

5.kind: Adverb 亦 annotated as :mod 亦 concept; gold omits it
5.cause: Annotator reified the additive adverb 亦 'also' as a node; gold does not annotate it.
5.convention: Additive/focus adverbs like 亦/也 are not annotated as separate concepts.

5.kind: 贞孝节烈 modifier node extra on the first 牌坊 and the second 牌坊 duplicated instead of reentrant
5.cause: Annotator created two separate 牌坊 nodes each with a 贞孝节烈 mod and linked them by coreference; gold uses one 牌坊 node (s5x8) with ARG0 reentrancy for 得到.
5.convention: Repeated mention of the same entity within a sentence is represented by reentrancy of a single node, not duplicate nodes.

5.kind: Coreference chains differ: 牌坊 chain broken/extra and 旌表 chain spurious; 制度 chain partial
5.cause: Annotator linked 旌表 events across sentences and chained 牌坊 mentions differently (using same-entity to a duplicate node); gold links 牌坊 to sentence 1 and 制度 to sentence 2 only.
5.convention: Coreference follows entity identity across sentences; modifier nominals like 旌表 are not coreferenced as events.

6.kind: Temporal expression of dynasty period modeled as coordinated :era (and of 明代/清代) instead of a single temporal unit 明清 with :unit 代 and :quant 2
6.check: a_entity_concept, a_entity_found, c_other_attributes, d_peripheral_event, d_peripheral_entity, e_peripheral_labels
6.cause: The annotator decomposed the compound 明清 and 二代 into two dynasty entities with an 'and' coordination and used :era. The gold treats 明清 as one temporal concept measured by a unit 代 with quantity 2 (the 二代 phrase) and attaches it with :temporal.
6.convention: A time-span phrase with a number and a measure word is annotated as a temporal node with :unit (the measure word) and :quant (the number), attached via :temporal. Compound names are not split into coordinated entities unless they are separate words.

6.kind: Missing document-level temporal relation: the event is anchored with the wrong form or the wrong node
6.cause: The annotator wrote (s6b :before document-creation-time), with the arguments in reverse order of the gold's (document-creation-time :before s6x). Since the event happened in the Ming-Qing past, the gold relation is document-creation-time :before event, and the annotator's direction was inverted, so it did not match.
6.convention: For a past event, the temporal relation is written with document-creation-time as the first argument as gold has it; the direction should reflect that the event is before the document time, and the annotator should be consistent with the gold's direction.

6.kind: Coreference chain for 牌坊 linked to the previous sentence's mention instead of the first mention, and chain membership differs (a spurious 年间 member in the annotator's chain)
6.cause: The annotator linked s6p to the s5 mention (s5p2) and treated the chain of 牌坊 mentions differently from gold, which links to the first mention (s1x). It also merged 年间 (s5p) into the chain, so the cluster membership diverges.
6.convention: Repeated mentions of the same entity are linked in a single chain of same-entity relations; non-identical entities such as time spans are not included in the entity's chain.

7.kind: Head/modifier of 政府当局 swapped (当局 head with 政府 mod instead of 政府 head with 当局 mod)
7.cause: Annotator treated the final noun 当局 as head of the compound; gold takes 政府 as the head concept and 当局 as its modifier.

7.kind: Extra :era on 拨发-01 and extra :aspect on events; era placed under the event instead of on the root identity-91
7.cause: Annotator attached the temporal phrase 在清代 to the nearest event and added aspect to 拨发-01, while gold attaches :era at the clause level (identity-91) and does not annotate aspect on the main verb of the identity clause. Annotator also added :aspect state on identity-91, which gold lacks.
7.convention: A fronted time-setting phrase for a copular/identity clause attaches to the identity-91 root; copular identity-91 roots and their ARG1 event have no :aspect annotated in this setup.

7.kind: Subset structure of 其中一种 wrong: annotator used :mod plus :quant 1 and a separate coref subset-of; gold uses :subset-of in the graph
7.cause: Annotator represented 三种方法的其中一种 as a mod of 方法 and emitted a document-level subset-of coref relation, instead of using the in-graph :subset-of relation for partitive 其中.
7.convention: Partitive expressions (其中一种, one of N) are annotated within the sentence graph with :subset-of linking the part to the whole set, not with :mod or document-level subset coref.

7.kind: 表扬 relation to 方法 and 旌表: annotator made 方法 :ARG1-of 表扬-01 with 旌表-01 as ARG1; gold uses :purpose of 方法 to 表扬-01, with 旌表 as a concept and 贞节 as :mod
7.cause: Annotator treated 表扬 as a relative clause modifying 方法 and 旌表 as an event (旌表-00) with ARG1 贞节. Gold treats 旌表 as a nominal concept (not a frame) modifed by 贞节, and 方法 as having a purpose of 表扬.
7.convention: A 'method for doing X' noun phrase takes :purpose to the X event; a nominalized object like 旌表 is a plain concept with :mod rather than an event with ARG1.

7.kind: Temporal relations wrong: annotator put everything :before DCT; gold has DCT :overlap identity-91 and 拨发 :after 兴建
7.cause: Annotator anchored the identity clause and events to the past because of 清代, but gold treats the generalizing identity statement as holding at DCT, while the 拨发 event is before DCT and ordered after 兴建 (purpose event). Annotator used :overlap for 兴建 and 拨发 instead. Annotator also tied 旌表 to :overlap 清代 rather than 表扬 being before DCT.
7.convention: Generic identity-91 statements are DCT :overlap; a purpose event is temporally before the main event (main :after purpose) and both are :before DCT; temporal relations go on the event (表扬) rather than the nominal concept.

7.kind: Extra modal annotations for 旌表 and 兴建-01
7.cause: Annotator gave full-affirmative to the purpose event 兴建 and to 旌表 (treated as event); gold omits modal for these (purpose event is not asserted; 旌表 is not an event).
7.convention: Purpose events are not given independent modal annotation; non-event nominal concepts get no modal node.

7.kind: Coreference chain errors: extra links for 旌表 and 拨发, 建, 当局 in later sentences; 牌坊 chain incomplete/mismatched
7.cause: Annotator over-linked repeated event/nominal words (旌表, 拨发-01, 当局, 建) as same-event/same-entity, and its 牌坊 chain missed several mentions (e.g., 年间) and included different ones; gold links 7x7 牌坊 back to s1 instead of s6 only.
7.convention: Only link mentions that refer to the same specific entity/event; generic repeated words are not automatically coreferent, and chain all mentions of the same entity.

8.kind: Argument structure of have-cause-91 reversed (cause/effect swapped)
8.cause: Annotator treated the 由于 clause (达不到) as the first argument and the 所以 clause (设立) as ARG2. Gold puts the consequence (设立) in ARG1 and the reason (达不到) in ARG2, following the 所以 ... structure.
8.convention: In have-cause-91, ARG1 is the effect/result clause and ARG2 is the cause/reason clause, regardless of the surface order of 由于/所以.

8.kind: Negation encoded in the lexical predicate 达不到 instead of polarity - on 达到-01; wrong concept and missing polarity; modal wrong
8.cause: Annotator kept the negative resultative complement 达不到 as one unsegmented predicate, did not lemmatize it to 达到, and did not add :polarity -. Because there is no polarity, the modal relation was marked full-affirmative instead of full-negative.
8.convention: Negation morphemes (不, 没, etc.) are factored out as :polarity - on the positive predicate lemma, and the modal annotation for a negated event is full-negative.

8.kind: Unnecessary sense-less predicates / missing PropBank sense -01 for 彰显 and 有限
8.cause: Annotator used -00 (no frame found) for 彰显 and 有限, while the gold uses -01 from the frameset.
8.convention: Use the PropBank roleset -01 where one exists for the predicate; reserve -00 for predicates with no frame.

8.kind: Wrong aspect on 有限 (state vs performance expected) and on 建 (performance vs process)
8.cause: Annotator judged 有限 as a state; the gold has the aspect on the evaluated 达到 etc. as performance and 建 as process (an ongoing purpose-activity). Annotator defaulted to performance for the purpose clause 建牌坊.
8.convention: Aspect is chosen for the event as described: an unbounded, purpose/habitual activity such as building (牌坊) is process, not performance.

8.kind: Core arguments misassigned: 当局 attached to the wrong predicate; 数目 as ARG1 vs ARG0 of 有限; 达到 lacks ARG0
8.cause: Because of the restructuring, the annotator put 当局 as ARG0 of 达不到 but not of 设立, so 设立 lacks ARG0 当局. It also used ARG1 for 数目 under 有限 where gold uses ARG0 (the thing that is limited, per the frame). The agent 当局 is also not shared with 达到 in gold.
8.convention: The agent of the main acting clause (设立) is its ARG0; arguments should follow the PropBank roleset's role labels (有限-01 takes ARG0 for the limited entity).

8.kind: Temporal 最后 attached to the wrong event (达不到 instead of 设立)
8.cause: The annotator attached 最后 to the 由于 clause's predicate as :temporal because of the sentence's word order, but it modifies the establishing event 设立 in the main clause.
8.convention: Sentence adverbs attach to the predicate of the clause they scope over (here the main-clause event 设立), not to the subordinate clause.

8.kind: Document-level temporal relations differ: spurious/mistaken relations for 达到, 有限, 彰显, 建, 拨发 and missing :after chain
8.cause: Annotator used :before DCT for the events and :overlap for 有限/彰显 with 达不到, and 建 overlap 拨发. Gold orders 拨发 after the others, with DCT before 拨发, and 拨发 after 建 / 有限 / 达到, and 有限 after 设立.

8.kind: Modal annotation: extra full-affirmative on have-cause-91 and on 拨发/建
8.cause: Annotator added modal edges for the have-cause-91 relation node and for the embedded 拨发/建 events, while the gold does not annotate these.
8.convention: Do not give modal relations to the have-cause-91 relational node, nor to events embedded in modifiers like purpose/relative-clause events that are not asserted in their own right.

8.kind: Coreference: wrong antecedent for 当局, and extra same-event/same-entity links
8.cause: Annotator linked 当局 to the sentence-7 predicate s7g, while the gold chain is anchored differently (政府 vs 当局), and added many same-event links for 守节/守孝/拨发/建 and 牌坊 that the gold does not mark as coreferent. Generic or re-mentioned type references (守节, 守孝, 牌坊) were over-linked.
8.convention: Link same-entity/same-event only for specific, identical referents; do not chain generic/non-specific mentions or repeated event-type mentions.

9.kind: Common noun 政府 annotated as a named entity (government-organization with name 北洋 政府) instead of a plain concept with a modifier
9.cause: The annotator treated 北洋政府 as a proper name and built a name node with an English category. The gold treats 政府 as the head concept and 北洋 as a :mod, with no name node.
9.convention: Descriptive noun phrases that include a modifier, such as 北洋政府, are annotated as a common-noun concept with a :mod child. A name structure is used only for clear proper names, and the head keeps its source-language lemma.

9.kind: 贞节 annotated as the :ARG1 of 旌表, where the gold uses :mod. 旌表 is also given a '-00' sense id and an extra :aspect activity.
9.cause: The annotator treated 旌表 as a predicate with a PropBank-style frame and gave 贞节 an argument role. The gold treats 旌表 as a plain noun concept and 贞节 as its modifier.
9.convention: A noun modifying another noun in a compound is attached with :mod. An event-like noun that serves as an object is not turned into a predicate with a roleset when it is a plain nominal concept.

9.kind: Wrong temporal relations. The annotator placed 实行 before the document creation time and 建立 before the document creation time, and gave 旌表 an :overlap relation with 实行. The gold has 实行 before the document creation time and 建立 after 实行, which is the wrong direction of 后 in the gold.
9.cause: The annotator did not encode the relation of the 后 clause to the main event as an :after relation between the two events. It also added a relation for the nominal 旌表, which the gold does not treat as an event.
9.convention: A 'X 后, Y' clause is encoded as a temporal relation between the two events, and each event is also related to the document creation time as needed. Nominal concepts that are not events do not get temporal relations.

9.kind: Extra modal annotation for 旌表, which the gold does not treat as an event
